verdict.rationale: Substantive text was quoted directly from public guidance pages on irs.gov and eftps.gov/eftps/, covering scheduling, MFA, enrollment and cutoff times. That implies the reading surface served real content rather than a JS-only shell or CAPTCHA. Probes against eftps.gov returned ordinary HTTP 404s rather than bot-wall challenges. However, no probe explicitly records fetching a guidance page with an identified agent user agent, and the absent robots.txt leaves agents with no stated crawl policy. Missing for 10: an explicit hands-on fetch of the guidance pages with a declared bot user agent showing a 200 with server-rendered content, confirmation that no CAPTCHA or WAF challenge applies to agents, and a published robots.txt crawl policy.
